KaTeX 0.19.0 — local browser distribution

Source release: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/tag/v0.19.0
Archive: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/download/v0.19.0/katex.tar.gz
Archive SHA256: 966d9c85655081cca9a57e8a1d667f13f96b1c85c3f93655a8acef74c4ce3875

Unmodified katex.min.js, katex.min.css, and all 60 distributed fonts.
No auto-render extension or runtime CDN is used. The fixed directory is served
at /vendor/katex; CSS-relative font paths must be preserved.

Code license: LICENSE (MIT), copied from the matching source tag.
Fonts: FONT-NOTICES.txt (embedded family notices) and OFL.txt (full SIL OFL 1.1).
OFL source: https://openfontlicense.org/documents/OFL.txt

JS/CSS integrity matches the official 0.19.0 browser installation documentation:
